notes: This repo is the workflow's own source. The runtime under _dev-workflow/ is an installed copy of lib/, scripts/ and hooks/ — edit the source at the repo root, then re-run the installer to refresh the copy. Never edit _dev-workflow/ directly.
The commit type is a release decision: semantic-release cuts on every push to main, so feat means a minor and fix a patch. Pick it accordingly.
Work with no issue behind it still uses the chore(no-ticket) escape; the type in it is incidental, so any conventional type plus (no-ticket) passes.
